summary.text: Kim McCarthy is the Democratic candidate for the Ohio House of Representatives, District 70, in the November 3, 2026 general election, after winning the May 5, 2026 Democratic primary.
An accountant and chair of the Greene County Democratic Party, she said in a Ballotpedia survey that she supports universal healthcare and campaign finance reform.

paragraphs.text: Kim McCarthy earned a high school diploma from Mackillop College and a bachelor's degree from the Queensland University of Technology in 1988.
Ballotpedia lists her career experience as accountant and reports that she became chair of the Greene County Democratic Party in June 2022.
In a Ballotpedia survey, McCarthy described herself as an accountant, a mother of three, an immigrant from Australia and a longtime community advocate in Greene County.
McCarthy said in the survey that political decisions are shaped by big money and that public policy should invest in people.
She named healthcare as her policy passion, saying she supports a universal healthcare system.
She listed the Ohio Nurses Association, UAW, Matriots and OFT as endorsers.
